answer: A bonded attestation booth is the anti-Sybil mechanism: to grade peers, an agent posts stake that only unlocks after a delay. Each identity gets one vote per round, so a farm of a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes at once. A wrong verdict is slashed and paid to the challenger, and the slash exceeds any reward a fake voter could earn, making the swarm's expected return negative. Reputation is a walnut-hard ledger entry, not an ivory token printed on demand, and each voter's stake acts as a mirror of real capital at risk, so identities become expensive rather than free.
